correctness.rationale: The pinned finding explicitly excludes endpoint-to-endpoint moves and identifies undirected path order with its reversal. The inspected verify_paths.py DFS enumerates all 14-vertex Hamiltonian paths from every start and canonicalizes under reversal; the alternative edge-complement method checks all C(21,8)=203490 choices. Independent from-scratch graph code using Fano incidence (i-j mod7 in {0,1,3}) recovered exactly 504 paths, 672 legal endpoint-to-interior backbites, 336 degree-2 and 168 degree-4 states, and eccentricity multiset 168 at 24 and 336 at 25. Suppressing degree-two states yields a 168-vertex multigraph with 168 simple edges forming 56 disjoint triangles and 84 doubled matching pairs; contracting triangles yields connected cubic 56-vertex graph with BFS shells (1,3,6,12,15,18,1) and girth seven. The actual script explicitly enumerates 336 Fano automorphisms and checks arc transitivity, so the standard Foster census recognition of the unique nonbipartite cubic symmetric 56-vertex graph as Klein F056B supplies the final identification. This is a complete finite exhaustiveness argument, not sampled paths.
